title: BOAXEL suspension rail
description: BOAXEL suspension rail, anthracite, 713/4" Slightly slanting and crooked might be fine – but not when mounting a storage system. Not to worry – this mounting rail makes it easy to hang BOAXEL wall uprights straight and correctly on the wall.
features: Together with a spirit level, use the holes at the ends of the mounting rail for the final vertical adjustments to ensure that the mounting rail is positioned straight on the wall.
The mounting rail is only a help during mounting, it should not be loaded with any weight.
The mounting rail can be cut to an exact width if needed. Only applicable when using more than one mounting rail or for the adjustable clothes rail and shelf.
Be aware that different wall materials are able to support different loads of weight. For instance, walls made of drywall cannot support as much weight as walls made of wood, concrete, or brick.
Different wall materials require different types of fasteners. Use fasteners suitable for the walls in your home.
If you are uncertain about what type of mounting devices to use, please contact your local hardware store.
The recommended maximum weight applies when the weight load is evenly distributed across the surface.
